name: emberline
description: A live ribbon above the prompt: usage left, context tokens and mix, cache warm or cold, plan progress, running agents and background work, plus optional keep-warm pings that hold the prompt cache while you are away.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before the cache goes cold
warnMinutes.description: Minutes left when a notification fires for a session over 100k tokens; off for none

autoKeepWarm.title: Keep large sessions warm on their own
autoKeepWarm.description: For a session over 100k tokens, switch keep-warm on for this long when a turn ends, unless you switched it off in that conversation; off for never
